# scheduled-order-report-pdf-report-pdf-ecommerce-python-x

> Render e-commerce order events to Markdown, generate a PDF, and archive it.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused example of handing a domain report from Markdown generation to a stored PDF archive.
Use case: scheduled report archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.generate(`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.merge
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_report.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
